awards_draft.mechanism: Awards and selections are results of voting or formula: production and advanced metrics, team success, games played (the 65-game rule with its Extraordinary Circumstances appeal for MVP, DPOY, MIP, All-NBA and All-Defensive) and narrative interact; All-NBA ballots are positionless; All-Star starters and reserves are positionless with a nationality minimum; the Hustle Award is a tracked-stat formula. Draft outcomes depend on lottery order, consensus rankings and trade/workout news. Mostly slow-moving until late-season/draft-week information arrives.

attach.why: Cup MVP depends on which team survives the group tiebreaks and the knockout games (higher seed hosts through the semifinal; neutral final).
65-game rule (20+ minutes in 63) gates MVP, DPOY, MIP, All-NBA and All-Defensive; ROY, Sixth Man, All-Rookie and the draft are exempt.
Cup group and knockout games count in the regular-season standings (the final does not) and shift rest and schedule density.

series_and_cup.mechanism: A best-of-seven series is a sequence of correlated games with 2-2-1-1-1 home structure and playoff-tightened rotations; probability of winner and length derive from per-game win probability with state-dependent updating (injuries, adjustments) and correlation. Cup outcomes follow group tiebreakers (point differential), one wild card per conference and single-elimination games hosted by the higher seed through the semifinal, with a neutral final (2026-27: Hinkle Fieldhouse). Both require rule-accurate simulation and availability-aware ratings.

attach.why: KXNBAPLAYOFF3D exposure is the number of playoff games the team plays, read from the shared bracket paths.

unreg:team_and_player_counting_specials.mechanism: A player reaches 50+ points in at least one playoff game: the probability is a union over a random number of playoff games of a single-game upper-tail event, driven by the team's playoff path (games available), the star's availability and playoff minutes and usage, and the scoring tail against playoff defenses; cumulative points across games do not count.
